checks_run_at_derivation: assert_projection_is_lossless: the kernel's fold and cross-review gate judge the raw and the projected events of every plan identically (risk ids and severities, claims, dispositions, decision) at the recorded cap and at the kernel default
scan_for_sensitive_data: no email, uuid, tenant schema, ip address, token, key, credential assignment or operator name in the fixture text
committed_on: the operator's 2026-10-25 decision to commit the replay fixture as a test (ARIA quality and learning program v2)
data: ARIA plan and risk records only: reviewer risk ids, severities and one-line summaries about repository code. No tenant data, no secrets, no personal data. ARIA's own redaction marker <secret-redacted> appears where the ledger's writer already withheld a value.
projection: per event type, only the payload fields the replay reads; the generator's _PROJECTIONS table is the list. Cut everywhere: ledger hash chain, idempotency keys, schema versions, timestamps, agent names, plan and challenger bodies, risk recommendations, affected files and evidence refs, coverage manifests and witnesses, implementation-phase events.
purpose: PV R9: replay the plans CONVERGED on aria/state through the plan-verdict law (finding ARIA-HIGH-779): under the old law each hid a new material risk behind the plan author's claim; under PV's law none converges.
selection: every plan whose ledger holds a plan_evaluated event with terminal_state CONVERGED; its events up to and including that evaluation, in ledger order, each tagged with its 1-based line in the source ledger (ledger_line)
